name: Warranty claims and field-return analysis
one_line: The controlled evidence chain from an in-service failure allegation through claim intake, entitlement decision, return authorization and receipt, teardown or laboratory investigation, disposition, corrective-action linkage, and aggregate field-failure analysis. It is anchored by a claim or quality-event identity and a returned unit, not by a sale, shipment, repair visit, generic complaint, or factory nonconformance alone. Placeholder template researched at full J-DEPTH; the manufacturing schema declares no fields, so this row writes fields: [] and recommends dimensions only in prose.

node_test.leg_1_detection_signals: The schema default recognizes making, inspecting, releasing and maintaining physical output. This row requires a different transaction: an in-service failure allegation tied to a claimant or installed unit, an entitlement or warranty-status decision, a return authorization or returned-unit receipt, and an investigation/disposition trail. A factory NCR can exist before shipment; a warranty claim begins with alleged failure after transfer or service exposure.
node_test.leg_2_dimension_order: The manufacturing default is branch-shaped around product plus batch/lot, asset, or quality event. This situation is quality-event-first: one claim must keep the intake, returned-unit chain, investigation and settlement together even when the manufacturing lot is unknown. Conditional on R1c promoting the schema proposals, the recommendation is product then quality_event then record_type; batch_lot is searchable when proven, not a required parent.
node_test.leg_3_privacy: Warranty material routinely joins a product failure admission to claimant contact details, serial numbers, purchase evidence, service location, photographs and reimbursement decisions. That is a different exposure from an internal traveller or inspection sheet and requires redaction-aware review before external model or connector use. This is an inference from the file structures; 00 supplies the general privacy-before-model rule, not a warranty-specific rule.

fields_note: Empty by contract. The manufacturing placeholder schema declares fields: [] and a template never copies its schema proposals. If R1c promotes them, this row uses product, quality_event and record_type as its principal facts, with batch_lot and asset only when the file itself proves those roles.
proposed_fields_note: No private claim_number, serial_number, failure_code, claimant, warranty_status or resolution field is minted. quality_event already proposes the case identity; product and asset cover the article roles where adjudicated; record_type covers document function. The remaining values belong in content/search or later controlled catalogues, not automatically in folder dimensions.

deterministic: a claim-intake structure with a labelled claim or case identifier, product or model, installed-unit or serial identity, reported in-service symptom, occurrence or discovery date, claimant/contact role, and entitlement/status slot; the joined roles are the signal, never the word warranty alone
a return-material authorization linking a claim identifier to a returned-unit identity, return reason, ship-to or return location, authorization status and return instructions

a returned-unit receipt or quarantine record linking the same claim/RMA identity to received condition, accessories or quantity, serial or lot observations, receipt date and custody/disposition status

a teardown or failure-analysis report that names the claim or returned unit and separates reported symptom, condition as received, examination or test performed, finding, failure mode or no-fault-found result, and disposition
a claim decision or settlement record joining entitlement basis, coverage decision, approved repair/replacement/credit action and authorization to the claim identity

a field-return trend table whose row unit is claim or returned unit and whose labelled columns combine product identity, symptom/failure mode, disposition and occurrence or receipt period; aggregate charts alone do not establish the underlying row semantics
a correspondence record whose subject or labelled body binds a claim/RMA identity to a returned unit and whose attachment list names the intake, label, investigation or decision artifact
an archive manifest joining intake, purchase evidence, return label, received-unit images, investigation and decision under one claim identity, inspected without extracting members to disk
needs_llm: distinguishing a customer's allegation from an investigator's confirmed failure mode when both appear in the same narrative
distinguishing warranty entitlement from goodwill accommodation, paid repair, product recall, insurance adjustment or ordinary return policy
deciding whether a photograph depicts the returned unit's condition, shipping damage, installation damage, a factory defect, or an unrelated product
mapping multilingual or OCR-poor claim forms whose visual slot relationships survive but labels do not
distinguishing a supplier chargeback packet from the end-customer claim that originated it; both may repeat the same part, serial and failure narrative
distinguishing a no-fault-found conclusion from an incomplete investigation or inability to reproduce
separating personally identifying claimant/contact content from product and failure evidence before any model path
never_alone: the words warranty, guarantee, claim, complaint, failure, defect, return, RMA, repair, replacement, credit or recall alone
a serial number, lot number, claim number, order number or other identifier-shaped token outside a labelled role and corroborating record structure
a product name, model, SKU, manufacturer, dealer, customer or service organization name alone
a receipt, invoice, order confirmation, packing list, shipping label or delivery confirmation alone; those prove commerce or movement, not a warranty case
a photograph of damage, corrosion, wear, leakage or a broken component without a claim/returned-unit association in the file's own evidence
a test result, failure-code value, pass/fail word, disposition or approval signature alone
an email subject saying broken, return requested or replacement sent without claim structure or a bound attachment
a file extension or source_type alone; PDF, spreadsheet, image, OCR, email and archive are routing clues
a parent folder called Warranty, Returns, Complaints or Quality, or a bounded download/scanning session
missing EXIF as proof that an image is a claim screenshot or returned-unit photograph

work_types: warranty claim intake or claim form
repair, replacement, credit or denial authorization
supplier recovery or chargeback support packet
grouping_reasons: one claim or RMA across intake, proof of purchase, return authorization, label, receipt, photographs, investigation, decision and correspondence
one returned unit across serial-bearing images, custody events, teardown results and disposition without copying the claimant or claim status onto sparse images
one product's field-return pattern across many claims, while each claim remains independently evidenced and reviewable
one confirmed field failure linked to an NCR/CAPA or engineering change as a relationship, never by copying the claim's facts onto the corrective record
duplicate and version families remain universal facts; neighbourhood membership cannot manufacture a claim number, product, serial, failure mode or entitlement decision

template.why: Machine-readable order is empty because the manufacturing schema declares no destination-eligible fields. Conditional on R1c promoting its proposals, recommend product -> quality_event -> record_type. This differs from product -> batch_lot because the manufacturing lot is often absent or learned only after investigation, while the claim identity binds every member from intake onward. Optional aggregate branch: product -> record_type for field-return registers spanning many claims. Optional unit-led branch: asset -> quality_event where a durable installed asset is independently identified. Claimant, contact, serial, failure code and settlement amount are never proposed as folder levels. The user may reverse, flatten or remove levels; this is not a path and is not time-first.

collides_with.signal: SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `FA-77194 AX410 Teardown Report.pdf` and the corrective-action record it cites. This row owns the customer/field transaction: allegation, entitlement, returned-unit custody, investigation and settlement under one claim identity. NONCONFORMANCE-CAPA owns the internal control event: requirement versus observed condition, containment, root cause, corrective action and effectiveness verification. The discriminating evidence is WHEN AND FOR WHOM the case exists: in-service claimant/return evidence supports this row; an internal affected-lot/disposition/action structure supports CAPA. RECIPROCAL: CAPA must not claim a warranty packet because its teardown mentions root cause, and this row must not claim an internal NCR because it mentions field impact.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Service Visit SV-4881 - AX410 leak.pdf`, which can record a customer's failure allegation, serial, diagnosis and parts replaced. FIELD-SERVICE owns performed work at an installed asset: arrival/departure, technician, site, labour/parts and returned-to-service outcome. THIS ROW owns entitlement and claim disposition plus the return/investigation chain. RECIPROCAL: field service must not infer warranty coverage from a repair visit, and this row must not claim a service report merely because the repaired unit may still be under warranty.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `ECR-1187_BPA-210_Bushing-Material.pdf`, whose reason-for-change cites a field-return trend and whose evidence packet includes a warranty teardown. ENGINEERING-CHANGE owns the controlled supersession: affected item, current/new revision, disposition and effectivity. THIS ROW owns the claim-to-return-to-failure-analysis transaction. RECIPROCAL: engineering change must not absorb the claimant packet because it motivated a revision, and this row must not treat the approved design change as a claim outcome.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `UPS Return Label RMA-77194.pdf` and its tracking events. LOGISTICS owns physical movement evidenced by carrier, origin/destination, tracking identity, milestones and delivery exception. THIS ROW owns why the unit is returning and what the warranty process decides. RECIPROCAL: logistics must not infer failure or entitlement from an RMA reference, and this row must not infer shipment completion from an issued label.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Ticket 55418 - AX410 leaking.eml`. SUPPORT-OPERATIONS owns the service interaction queue: requester, channel, assignment, response and resolution history. THIS ROW owns a product-warranty transaction only after entitlement, return authorization, returned-unit or investigation evidence appears. RECIPROCAL: support must not turn every defect report into a warranty case, and this row must not claim a troubleshooting ticket because the word replacement occurs in conversation.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Order 88421 return request - defective.pdf`. RETAIL RETURNS owns the merchant transaction: order line, return window/policy, refund/exchange and inventory receipt. THIS ROW owns the manufacturer's technical field-return chain: installed-unit identity, entitlement basis, teardown/failure finding and corrective linkage. RECIPROCAL: retail returns must not claim a failure-analysis dossier because a refund was issued, and this row must not claim a change-of-mind return because the policy document says warranty.

SAME FIXTURE BOTH SIDES: `Defects Register - AHU-4 warranty period.xlsx`, a located fault list that names equipment, responsible contractor, status and re-inspection. SNAGGING-DEFECTS owns a defect in the works, discriminated by room/plot/location, trade responsibility, practical-completion or defects-period context and reinspection. THIS ROW owns a manufactured product claim, discriminated by product/model or serial, claimant/entitlement, return authorization and returned-unit investigation. RECIPROCAL: snagging must not claim a product teardown because the unit was installed in a building, and this row must not claim a construction defects register because it calls the period warranty.

also_holds_with_note: Empty by contract: also_holds_with is schema-to-schema record-template intent and this is a template row. Legitimate multi-schema readings are recorded per file through also_schema and do not widen the manufacturing schema here.

falls_through_to.when: a technical-looking record lacks a defensible claim, return or field-failure association
the evidence establishes only a purchase, issued label, dispatch, refund or delivery confirmation
a damage photograph has no independently evidenced claim or accepted returned-unit group
claimant/contact, purchase, address or settlement evidence requires protection but deeper warranty association is not reliable
an encrypted or unsupported packet cannot be inspected sufficiently to establish the transaction

sensitivity_why: Claim files can expose claimant identity and contact details, purchase and location evidence, unique unit identifiers, allegations of unsafe or defective performance, internal root-cause discussion, supplier responsibility and reimbursement decisions. Protection is required before model or connector use; serial or claimant values are not destination dimensions.
open_question: NEEDS-JOSEPH NJ-WARRANTY-1: confirm whether warranty claims remain product-manufacturing evidence when no physical return occurs and the decision is made from remote diagnostics. Current recommendation: yes only when claim identity, entitlement and product-specific diagnostic/disposition structure are present; otherwise support-operations owns it. NJ-WARRANTY-2: confirm the retail/manufacturer boundary when one merchant is also manufacturer. Current recommendation follows evidence grammar, not organization identity: order/refund policy is retail_hospitality.returns-warranty; returned-unit investigation and field-failure control is this row. NJ-WARRANTY-3: if R1c rejects manufacturing's quality_event proposal, this template has no legal organizing anchor and must keep dimension_order empty rather than mint claim_number privately.
